newsitem.title: UK: Northern says MMC issue dogs market response.
newsitem.headline: Northern says MMC issue dogs market response.

text.p: British utility Northern Electric Plc said on Friday the uncertainty over whether CE Electric's takeover bid would be referred to the monopolies watchdog continued to overshadow the market's response to the deal terms.

The comments were made in a statement late Friday. "The Board continues to believe that uncertainty as to whether CE Electric's bid will be referred to the MMC (Monopolies and Mergers Commission) is currently dominating the market's reaction to the offer. Attempts by CE Electric to construct arguments around current movements in Northern Electric's share price are misguided," said the UK utility.
The offer for Northern is being made by CE Electric, a 70-percent owned unit of U.S. group CalEnergy. CalEnergy's bid is worth 630 pence per share.
But Northern has claimed that CalEnergy had suggested a price of 700 pence per share before making the offer - a claim the predator denies.
